title: Draftsman/women
description:
**Company Description**
iama designers and developers LLP is an architecture and interior design firm founded in 2011 by two entrepreneurs from Calicut, Kerala. The firm focuses on innovative, functional, and aesthetically driven design solutions for a wide range of clients. With over 150 completed residential and commercial projects by 2020, the company has built a strong reputation for quality and timely delivery. Team members collaborate closely to bring creative concepts to life and ensure client satisfaction throughout the design and execution process.
  
**Role Description**
The Draftsperson will support architects and interior designers by preparing detailed architectural and interior drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, and 3D representations as needed. Day-to-day tasks include converting conceptual sketches into accurate technical drawings, updating drawings based on design changes, coordinating with the design team, and ensuring that drawings comply with relevant standards and project requirements. The role also involves organizing drawing files, assisting in documentation for project approvals, and communicating with site teams to clarify design details when required. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kerala, India.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong technical drafting skills using CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD) and familiarity with 3D design tools (e.g., SketchUp, Revit, or similar).
* Understanding of architectural and interior design principles, building materials, and construction detailing.
* Ability to interpret sketches and design concepts and convert them into precise drawings and documentation.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with architects, designers, and site teams.
* Diploma or degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Interior Design, or a related field.
* Prior experience as a Draftsperson in architecture or interior design firms is preferred.
* Attention to detail, commitment to accuracy, and a willingness

title: Video Creator & Editor
description:
**About Bafar Labs**

Bafar Labs is an AI studio, agency and software development firm building enterprise AI systems for global markets. We build our own suite of AI products, along with custom AI solutions engineered to each client’s exact needs, for businesses across APAC, the GCC and the US.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Video Creator & Editor to create short-form video for Bafar Labs and our three founders, mainly for Instagram Reels. You will shoot on mobile, edit fast, and turn our AI products, client work and everyday moments at the office into reels that stop the scroll and grow our reach. Every video has three seconds to hook the viewer, and making those seconds count will be your job.

**What You Will Do**

* Plan a reel strategy with the content team: formats, hooks and posting schedule
* Shoot reels on smartphone: founder talks, product demos, client stories and office moments
* Get framing, lighting, stabilisation and audio right for vertical 9:16 video
* Direct founders and team members on camera so they look and sound confident
* Edit reels with strong hooks, captions, text overlays, transitions and trending audio
* Cut longer videos into multiple short clips
* Track views, watch time and retention, and double down on what performs

**What We Are Looking For**

* 1+ year shooting and editing short-form video, mainly on mobile
* A portfolio of reels you shot and edited yourself, ideally with view counts
* Strong with mobile editing apps such as Edits (by Instagram) and CapCut
* Comfortable using a gimbal, portable lights and wireless mics
* Up to date with Instagram trends, formats and audio
* Premiere Pro or After Effects is a plus
* Immediate joiners preferred

**What We Offer**

* Real AI products and client stories to bring to life on video
* Creative freedom to experiment with formats and ideas
* Room to grow as our marketing team grows
* Additional benefits, to be discussed during the interview process

**How to Apply**

Apply with Easy Apply by 7 November 2026. In your resume, include links to 3 reels you shot and edited (Instagram, Google Drive or YouTube), or combine your resume and portfolio into one PDF. Applications with work samples will be reviewed first.

Questions? Email info@bafarlabs.com
